title: Loan Amortization Calculator
h1: Loan Amortization Calculator — Monthly Payment & Schedule
seoTitle: Loan Amortization Calculator — Free Online | ToolNova
description: Calculate the monthly payment, total interest and a summary amortization schedule for any fixed-rate loan. All math stays in your browser.
intro: Enter the loan amount, annual interest rate and term in years. See the fixed monthly payment, total interest paid and how the balance decreases.
blurb: Calculate loan payments and amortization summary privately in the browser.
howItWorks: Enter the principal amount you plan to borrow.
Enter the annual interest rate and the repayment term in years.
Click Calculate to see the fixed monthly payment and total interest.
examples: A $10,000 loan at 5% for 5 years has a monthly payment of about $188.71.
Use it to compare different rates or terms before applying for a personal or auto loan.
See how much of the total repayment is interest versus principal.

faq.q: Does this include taxes or insurance?
faq.a: No. It calculates principal and interest only for a fixed-rate loan.
This version shows the standard schedule. Extra principal payments would reduce total interest and shorten the term.
It uses the standard amortization formula used by most lenders for fixed-rate installment loans.
